title: CapCut Auto Reframe alternative: no Pro, no upload
description: CapCut moved Auto Reframe to Pro. Vertical turns a landscape clip into 9:16 and keeps the speaker in frame, on your device. Free up to 60 seconds.
ogTitle: A CapCut Auto Reframe alternative with no Pro plan
ogDescription: AI that follows the speaker, on your device. No install, no account, no upload.
h1: A CapCut Auto Reframe alternative, no Pro plan
sub: AI follows the speaker, on your device.
body: CapCut moved Auto Reframe to the Pro plan in April 2026. Here a 9:16 window follows the speaker; 1080p becomes 608×1080.
not: Follows one person; for two, hold still and drag.
It does not enlarge; rivals promise 1080×1920.

questions.a: Not now. CapCut's help page says it was "moved to the CapCut Pro (premium) tier as part of ongoing product development".

It follows one of them; hold still, then drag the window to the other. Choppity, which takes an upload, says its tool "detects multiple speakers and creates split-screen layouts or switches focus to the active speaker automatically".
No. It stays on your device, and there is no account.
